property_summary: Rule: withdrawAll by an address with zero credit must succeed without making any external call (so even a reverting callee cannot cause a revert); the mutant `oCredit >= 0` always calls msg.sender, so a zero-credit caller whose receive reverts makes withdrawAll revert.
change_summary: Change the guard from `oCredit > 0` to `oCredit >= 0` so the external call is made even when the caller has no credit.
